run_conversational_pipeline: run a conversational pipeline using a PaddleNLP dialogue model from HuggingFace Hub
create_conversation_with_history: create a multi-turn conversation by passing past user inputs and generated responses
build_dialogue_pipeline: build a dialogue pipeline that accepts text input and returns bot responses with conversation state

refactor_conversational_pipeline: refactor the ConversationalPipeline class to support a different dialogue model or input format
